fields.help: Either this or Table must be set. Takes precedence over Table/Data/Where when both are given.

fields.label: Table

fields.help: Column/value pairs for insert or update, used only in table-builder mode.
fields.label: Row Data (JSON object)

fields.help: Raw SQL boolean expression (no leading WHERE). Required for update/delete in table-builder mode.
